request_text: I used this Yahoo address before changing the email on my account. Please remove records linked to both the old and current addresses.
Solicito la eliminación permanente de la cuenta asociada a este correo. Revisen los identificadores actuales y anteriores.
Could you send me a copy of the data you hold on my account? Please do not delete anything.
I was told the account had been deleted, but I can still find traces in search, support, and analytics. Please handle them and disable any synchronization that could recreate them.
